sloka: स तु विज्ञाय तपसा वानरेण कृतं हि तत् ।उत्ससर्ज महाशापं क्षेप्तारं वालिनं प्रति ॥४-११-५२॥।।
transliteration: sa tu vijñāya tapasā vānareṇa kṛtaṁ hi tat ।utsasarja mahāśāpaṁ kṣeptāraṁ vālinaṁ prati ॥4-11-52॥।।

translations.english: 'Having known through his ascetic vision that it was the act of a monkey, he pronounced a curse on Vali who had hurled (the body):
